tests.key: api::tests/api/Accounts.spec.ts::ACC-01 new customer has one funded checking account
tests.title: ACC-01 new customer has one funded checking account

annotations.description: GET /api/accounts for a freshly registered customer returns exactly one account, of type CHECKING, with balance 1000.

tests.key: api::tests/api/Accounts.spec.ts::ACC-02 opens savings account funded with 100
tests.title: ACC-02 opens savings account funded with 100

annotations.description:
Opening a SAVINGS account returns success. The new account has balance 100, and the source account drops 
        by exactly 100 (verified by reading both back through GET /api/accounts).

tests.key: api::tests/api/Accounts.spec.ts::ACC-03 rejects savings opening with insufficient funds
tests.title: ACC-03 rejects savings opening with insufficient funds

annotations.description: Opening a SAVINGS account from a source account with a balance below 100 returns 400, and no account is created.

responseBody.error: Insufficient funds to open a new account

tests.title: ACC-04 rejects non-savings account type

annotations.description: Opening an account with a type other than SAVINGS returns 400, and no account is created.

responseBody.error: Only SAVINGS can be opened (CHECKING is created at registration)

tests.key: api::tests/api/Auth.spec.ts::AUTH-01 creates customer with funded checking account
tests.title: AUTH-01 creates customer with funded checking account

annotations.description: POST /api/register returns 201 with customerId, username, checkingAccountId; checking balance is 1000.00 (verified via GET /api/accounts)

tests.title: AUTH-02: rejects missing required field

annotations.description: POST /api/register with a required field omitted returns 400, and the fields array names the missing field.

tests.title: AUTH-03: rejects duplicate username

annotations.description: POST /api/register Registering a second customer with an already-used username returns 409.

tests.key: api::tests/api/Auth.spec.ts::AUTH-04: logs in with valid credentials
tests.title: AUTH-04: logs in with valid credentials

annotations.description: POST /api/login with correct credentials returns 200 with the customer, and the session cookie is set (verified by a following authenticated call).

tests.key: api::tests/api/Auth.spec.ts::AUTH-05: rejects wrong password and unknown username
tests.title: AUTH-05: rejects wrong password and unknown username

annotations.description: POST /api/login with a wrong password, and separately with an unknown username, returns 400 in both cases.

tests.key: api::tests/api/Auth.spec.ts::AUTH-06: /api/me returns 401 without session, customer with session
tests.title: AUTH-06: /api/me returns 401 without session, customer with session

annotations.description: GET /api/me with no session returns 401. With a registered session it returns 200 and the correct customer.

tests.key: api::tests/api/Auth.spec.ts::AUTH-07: blocks account access after logout
tests.title: AUTH-07: blocks account access after logout

annotations.description: After logout, GET /api/accounts returns 401. access must be blocked once the session has ended

tests.key: api::tests/api/BillPay.spec.ts::BILL-01 pays a bill from checking and records a debit
tests.title: BILL-01 pays a bill from checking and records a debit

annotations.description:
A valid bill payment from the checking account returns success. 
      The balance drops by exactly the paid amount (checked in the response and by a second GET /api/accounts), 
      and the payment appears in the transaction history as a Debit for that amount.

responseBody.message: Bill Payment to Electric Checking Co in the amount of $100.00 from account #5021 was successful.

tests.title: BILL-02 pays a bill from savings and records a debit

annotations.description:
The same payment made from the savings account: the balance drops by exactly the paid amount, 
      and the payment appears in the transaction history as a Debit for that amount..

responseBody.message: Bill Payment to Electric Savings Co in the amount of $50.00 from account #5024 was successful.

tests.title: BILL-03 rejects negative amount

annotations.description: A bill payment with a negative amount returns 400, and the account balance is unchanged.

responseBody.error: Amount must be a positive number

tests.title: BILL-04 rejects insufficient funds

annotations.description: A bill payment larger than the account balance returns 400, and the account balance is unchanged.

tests.title: LOAN-03 denies loan above the limit

tests.title: LOAN-04 denies down payment above source balance

tests.title: TRF-01 moves money between own accounts
